# Dashboard features

<!-- GENERATED by `pnpm ui:docs` from packages/dashboard/src/ui/features.ts. Do not edit. -->

Every feature of the pxsig dashboard: what it is for, the states it handles, how it is used, its copy keys
(`src/copy/en.json`) and the UI contract components it renders. An adapter that renders these components
well renders every feature; see [build-adapter.md](build-adapter.md).

## Shell

### Top bar

`shell.top-bar` · The report's title (its label, else the project name) with the versions on hover, the section links with their counts, and the controls pinned at the end: start review, project, modes, connection with whether this page can approve (Read only / Can approve, the command for a dashboard link on hover), last check, theme, review status.

States:

- **loading**: The page shows a loading line until the first data arrives.
- **error**: The page shows the load error instead of the dashboard.
- **offline**: The connection badge reads Offline; the review button is hidden.
- **static**: The connection badge reads Static report · Read only; nothing that writes is shown.
- **readOnly**: Live · Read only: this page holds no dashboard link; the review buttons are disabled.
- **canApprove**: Live · Can approve: this page opened the dashboard link.

Interactions:

- Open a section (a plain #<id> link; Back and Forward move between sections)
- Start a review session on the next queue with undecided entries
- Switch project (when the server holds more than one)

Components: `AppShell`, `AppMain`, `TopNav`, `NavList`, `NavLink`, `NavEnd`, `Badge`, `StatusBadge`, `Button`, `Select`, `Tooltip`

### Coverage banner

`shell.coverage-banner` · Shown on every section while the coverage ledger has errors, or entries wait for a first approval: the headline, setup problems, a link to Coverage and the safe repair. On the Overview the errors card carries the errors instead, so they are not shown twice.

States:

- **static**: No repair button: a static report cannot write.

Interactions:

- View the components with problems
- Run the safe repair (never approves, never writes a signature)

### React progress strip

`shell.react-strip` · At the top of every section while the server analyses React files (with Skip) or measures renders (with Cancel), then how the run ended (the alerts in one line, skipped, failed, measured, cancelled) until dismissed. Never takes focus, blocks or counts down; only the start and the end are announced.

States:

- **loading**: A bar per run going on, with its count.
- **error**: The analysis failed: what happened, and that checks are not affected.
- **offline**: The rows stay as they were; Skip and Cancel are disabled.
- **static**: Not shown.
- **readOnly**: Skip and Cancel are disabled: they need the dashboard link.

Interactions:

- Skip the analysis; Cancel the measuring
- Open React or Renders from the end line; Dismiss it

Components: `Progress`, `Button`, `Alert`, `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`

### React Compiler

`diagnostics.react-compiler` · The React Compiler's verdict on the changed component and hook files, at the merge base and now: alerts first (newly skipped, new and skipped, a new reason, a new finding), every function analysed on demand, and one function's diagnostics, base and entries in a side panel. The title names the compiler that ran: the project's babel-plugin-react-compiler, or the built-in one (oxc, experimental). Alerts only: nothing here fails a check or asks for a decision.

States:

- **loading**: Analysing: a progress row with Skip; the table keeps the last results, busy.
- **empty**: No results yet, with Analyse; no alerts, or no changed files, in the table.
- **error**: The last analysis failed: what happened, and that checks are not affected.
- **static**: No Analyse: a static report cannot run anything.
- **readOnly**: Analyse and Skip are disabled: they need the dashboard link.
- **canApprove**: Analyse and Skip work (they decide nothing).

Interactions:

- Choose Compiler or Renders
- Analyse now; Skip a running analysis
- Alerts or every function analysed; search
- Open a function's details; open an entry it reaches in the inspector (Esc closes)

### React renders

`diagnostics.react-renders` · React's commits and renders per entry, counted while pxsig rendered it: the entries React was still committing at capture first, every entry measured on demand, and one entry's counts, top components and counts before in a side panel. Measure renders runs a visual check of the entries in scope with counting on; Cancel stops it, and the entries rendered by then keep their new results.

States:

- **loading**: Measuring: a progress row with Cancel; Measure renders is disabled.
- **empty**: No render counts yet: what Measure renders does.
- **static**: No Measure renders and no Scope.
- **readOnly**: Measure renders and Cancel are disabled: they need the dashboard link.
- **canApprove**: Measure renders and Cancel work (a re-check, not a decision).

Interactions:

- Scope: every entry, the ones shown, or the one in the side panel
- Measure renders; Cancel a run
- Alerts or every entry measured; open an entry's details or the inspector (Esc closes)

## Inspector

### React in the inspector

`inspector.react` · In the header, beside the verdict: a Still rendering badge when React was still committing at capture (its title is the alert), a likely cause of a flaky entry; it never changes the verdict, the decision buttons or the review queue. In the side panel, after Accessibility: the entry's render counts, whether React had settled, its top components and the counts before, and the React Compiler alerts whose file reaches the entry, each opening Diagnostics › React on that function. Neither in the Storybook panel.

Interactions:

- Open a compiler alert in Diagnostics › React

### Inspector header

`inspector.header` · The entry id, its context and reasons, its verdict, its other modes and states, the position in the list, the review buttons and Close. Reject opens a row under the header for an optional reason (one line, at most 280 characters; `rejections.note.ask: false` rejects at once). A rejected entry's note gives its reason, the re-check command, Edit reason and Copy for an agent (one paragraph for an assistant); an entry checked again since its rejection shows Rejected earlier with Dismiss reason; a reason or packet the server did not keep says so.

States:

- **static**: No review buttons.
- **readOnly**: A note under the header gives the command for a dashboard link, with a copy button; Reject, Approve and Undo stay in place, disabled.

Interactions:

- Approve or reject (accept, in an accessibility session) (A / R)
- Reject with the reason typed, or none; cancel the reason (Enter / Esc)
- Edit reason, copy for an agent, dismiss an earlier reason
- Previous or next entry (← → (J / K))
- Switch mode or state of the same story
- Close (Esc)

### Masks

`inspector.masks` · The masks on the entry's render (`data-volatile` elements, a story's `ignore`, `capture.ignore` of the project or workspace): in the side panel, after Pixel Changes, a Masks section with each mask's selector, where it came from, its reason and its share of the capture; when the masks changed since the baseline, Added, Removed or Grew and both shares. A masks-only change (the masks failed the entry and no pixel differs) says so in the change stepper and Pixel Changes, and puts the Masks section first. In the header and on the entry's card, Masks changed and Large mask (a mask over 25% of the capture, a warning, never a verdict); Overview lists the entries with a large mask while there are any, and Review Stories filters them.

Interactions:

- Open the entries with a large mask from Open items

Components: `Badge`

### Report to pxsig

`inspector.report` · A gate report for a public issue on hydrotik/pxsig, when the gate got an entry wrong (the header's Report to pxsig button, beside Re-check). The dialog first re-renders the entry on this machine and says whether it still fails the gate, then previews exactly what is copied: one image (baseline, render and diff, cropped to the changed regions) or the image-free summary, and the text in the issue form's shape, with the story ID replaced by entry-1. It says the issue is public and cannot be fully removed. Copy text, Copy image (one PNG; Save image where the clipboard takes no images), Open issue (the prefilled form, in a new tab) and Cancel; nothing is copied until a copy button is pressed, and nothing is posted.

States:

- **readOnly**: Available: preparing a report decides nothing.
- **static**: No Report to pxsig button: a static report has no server to re-render or compare.
- **loading**: The re-render on this machine, then the report, each with a line saying so.
- **error**: Why there is no report (no baseline, no render), or why the re-render failed.

Interactions:

- Full capture, Keep story ID, Image-free: the preview follows
- Copy text, Copy image or Save image; Open issue; Cancel (Esc)

Components: `IconButton`, `Icon`, `Dialog`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `Alert`, `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `Switch`, `Button`

### Decision window

`embed.decide` · The small window the Storybook panel's Approve, Reject and Accept go through: the panel is a frame on another site, where the dashboard link is not sent, so the window (this server's own page) takes the decision from the panel, posts it and closes. Without the dashboard link it stays open and says to open the link first; a tab without it shows the same instruction under the inspector's header.

States:

- **error**: The decision was not recorded: the reason, or the instruction to open the dashboard link first.
- **empty**: Opened on its own (no panel behind it): a line saying it has nothing to do.

Interactions:

- Approve, reject or accept in the Storybook panel opens it; it closes once the decision is recorded
